Charming All-Brick Ranch – Beautifully Maintained Inside & Out!

Welcome home to this beautifully maintained all-brick ranch offering timeless charm and comfortable one-floor living. This inviting home features 3 spacious bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, and hardwood floors that add warmth and character.

The bright eat-in kitchen provides the perfect space for everyday meals and gatherings, while newer windows enhance energy efficiency and fill the home with natural light. The partially finished basement offers additional living space that's ideal for a family room, home office, recreation area, or workout room, along with plenty of storage.

Outside, you'll appreciate the 2-car garage with a convenient enclosed Florida room, perfect for relaxing, entertaining, or enjoying the seasons in comfort. The home sits on a nicely landscaped yard with a concrete driveway, offering excellent curb appeal and low-maintenance living.

This move-in-ready home combines quality construction, thoughtful updates, and pride of ownership throughout. Don't miss your opportunity to make this wonderful ranch your next home!

Showings begin immediately; offers reviewed as received. Sellers reserve the right to add an offer deadline.
